review: S12 independent data and atomicity review
checks: Per-document ledger transaction guards the active job, desired revision and content hash, and rolls back metadata, chunks and links together on injected failure.
Per-document keyword transaction replaces segments and FTS rows atomically; an injected keyword failure retains the prior cache and durable keyword_dirty marker for retry.
A source-root or tokenizer mismatch keeps the committed cache and stale diagnostic unchanged. New saved documents derive into the ledger without making incompatible keyword rows queryable.
Malformed category and YAML-list documentTags do not erase or pollute prior valid user metadata; source aliases and document identity remain intact.
Flat inline YAML tag lists normalize, while nested list and object fragments yield no indexed tags and a parse diagnostic.
A cache revision ahead of the authoritative ledger is replaced by the guarded ledger revision, and retry clears keyword_dirty only after keyword commit.

focusedEvidence.result: [alpha, beta] and alpha, beta normalize without diagnostic; nested list/object fragments produce no tags with diagnostic

contractNote: On an incompatible cache, completed_revision may equal desired_revision while keyword_dirty remains 1. This records completed authoritative derivation and a deferred keyword cache; the stale diagnostic and Settings rebuild requirement prevent exposure of the old cache. Transient keyword commit failures instead keep a retryable desired job.
